regulatory_history.title: State of Texas v. The Allstate Corp. et al. (Cause No. 25-01-00561)
regulatory_history.notes: Brought under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, the Data Broker Law and the Insurance Code. Pending against the remaining defendants. Life360 is not a defendant.

procedural_note.text: On 2025-04-10 the Texas court dismissed The Allstate Corporation and Arity 875 LLC for lack of personal jurisdiction (MLex). The State appealed the dismissal of Arity 875, and the appeal was submitted on 2026-05-21 without a decision yet; the case continues against the remaining Allstate entities.
